displayIdentity.body: Confidence is renewed through Titus’s report. For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth. I rejoice that in everything I am confident about you.
displayIdentity.title: Confidence is renewed through Titus’s report
